directlyShown: The completed Searcher is a four-legged walker with a central operator cockpit.
Two different articulated arms flank the forward cockpit: a pincer claw and an orange-dish-ended tool.
A raised segmented tail crane ends in an orange handling head; the main body contains the meteorite compartment.
A small separate flyer mounts beneath that compartment in the source configuration.
The independent bay/docking structure and minifigures are separate set elements, not geometry of the Searcher unit.
The source uses tan/brown structural masses with orange tools, gray connections, and Sand Purple pneumatic elements.
inferred: The uploaded cropped photograph is an image-framing derivative of a secondary completed-set photograph; it does not alter the source model.
unknownOrDisputed: The exact fictional purpose of the orange-dish-ended front tool is not established consistently by the official instructions and independent commentary. Preserve its source-visible shape; do not name it a drill or add mechanics to the model target.
The manual does not prescribe a game gait or the game's stationary siege/clamp animation. Those are not part of this visual approval.
correctionsToEarlierT082Draft: Replace the claim of a long drill and paired front claws: the source shows one pincer claw arm and a distinct orange-dish-ended arm; the dish tool's exact purpose remains unverified.
Replace the claimed underslung material sled/container with the central meteorite compartment and the separate small flyer mounted below it.

Do not describe the walker as asymmetrical as a whole. The source confirms four legs; its unlike tools and rear crane are separate functional forms, not proof of generalized left/right chassis asymmetry.
Use the 7316 source palette (tan/brown with orange and Sand Purple mechanisms); blue/sand-red/trans-neon-green is not the 7316 main walker palette.
